keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across repo name and description (e.g. "llm agent", "vector database"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

language.title: Language
language.description: Programming language to filter by, e.g. "Python", "TypeScript", "Rust". Leave blank for all languages.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: GitHub topic tag to filter by, e.g. "web-scraping", "llm-agent". Leave blank for all topics.

minStars.title: Minimum stars
minStars.description: Only return repos with at least this many stars.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by repo creation date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of repos to return, most starred first.
